items.title: Wembanyama Scores 50 as Spurs Crush Pelicans 114-91
items.titleZh: 溫班亞瑪狂砍 50 分 馬刺 114 比 91 大勝鵜鶘
items.teaser: 只打 32 分鐘就 50 分 18 籃板，還有 5 火鍋 4 抄截！溫班亞瑪寫下 1973-74 球季以來沒人做到的紀錄，馬刺近 15 場拿下 14 勝。
paras: Victor Wembanyama scored 50 points and grabbed 18 rebounds as the San Antonio Spurs crushed the New Orleans Pelicans 114-91 on Saturday night. He also had five blocks and four steals in only 32 minutes.
聖安東尼奧馬刺週六晚上以 114 比 91 大勝紐奧良鵜鶘，溫班亞瑪（Victor Wembanyama）攻下 50 分、抓下 18 個籃板。他只打了 32 分鐘，還送出 5 次火鍋、4 次抄截。

Wembanyama made 20 of his 29 shots, including five 3-pointers. He already had 32 points and 13 rebounds by halftime, when the Spurs led 61-45. He reached 50 with a 3-pointer that made it 108-82 with 6:29 left, and then he left the game.
溫班亞瑪 29 投 20 中，其中包括 5 記三分球。上半場結束時他就已經拿到 32 分、13 籃板，馬刺當時以 61 比 45 領先。比賽剩 6 分 29 秒時，他投進一記三分球、把比分拉開到 108 比 82，同時達到 50 分，接著就退場休息。

According to the NBA, he is the first player since 1973-74 to record at least 50 points, 15 rebounds, four steals and five blocks in a game. Stephon Castle added 19 points for San Antonio, which has won 14 of its last 15 games. "I just want to keep stacking them up," Wembanyama said.
根據 NBA 的資料，他是 1973-74 球季以來，第一位在單場比賽拿下至少 50 分、15 籃板、4 抄截和 5 火鍋的球員。卡斯爾（Stephon Castle）幫馬刺貢獻 19 分，馬刺近 15 場拿下 14 勝。溫班亞瑪說：「我只想繼續把勝場一場一場累積下去。」
words: crushes · crushed · crushing｜n. crush 壓碎；迷戀｜crush the opponent 痛宰對手
複數 blocks｜v. block 阻擋（blocks · blocked · blocking）｜n. blocker 阻擋者
複數 steals｜v. steal 偷（steals · stole · stolen · stealing）
不可數｜by halftime 到上半場結束時｜at halftime 中場時
records · recorded · recording｜n. record /ˈrekɚd/ 紀錄｜break a record 打破紀錄

analysis.zh: 他投進一記三分球、把比分變成 108 比 82 而達到 50 分，當時比賽剩 6 分 29 秒，然後他就退場了。
parts: 修飾（with + 名詞 + 分詞，表示當時狀況）
and then he left the game.
對等子句（and then 接下一個動作）
analysis.note: that made it 108-82 是關係子句，that 代替前面的 a 3-pointer，說明這球造成的結果。with 6:29 left 是「with + 名詞 + 過去分詞」的附帶狀況，球賽新聞常用 with X seconds/minutes left 表示「剩下多少時間時」。注意兩個 left 意思不同：前面是「剩下的」，後面 left the game 是 leave 的過去式「離開」。

analysis.zh: 根據 NBA，他是 1973-74 球季以來，第一位在單場比賽拿下至少 50 分、15 籃板、4 抄截和 5 火鍋的球員。
parts: to record at least 50 points, 15 rebounds, four steals and five blocks
不定詞片語（修飾 the first player）
analysis.note: the first + 名詞 + to V 是固定句型：「第一個做某事的人」，例如 the first woman to walk on the Moon。這裡用不定詞 to record，而不是關係子句 who recorded，比較簡潔。according to… 放句首表示消息來源，後面要加逗號。

quiz.q: How many minutes did Wembanyama play?
quiz.ex: 第一段：in only 32 minutes。18 是籃板數，29 是出手數，50 是得分。

quiz.q: What was the score at halftime?
quiz.ex: 第二段：by halftime, when the Spurs led 61-45。108-82 是他投進第 50 分時的比分，114-91 是最終比分。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The Spurs have lost 14 of their last 15 games.
Wembanyama made all of his shots.
quiz.ex: 第三段：Stephon Castle added 19 points。溫班亞瑪剩 6 分 29 秒就退場；馬刺是近 15 場贏 14 場；他是 29 投 20 中。

items.title: Musk Says Memory Price Hikes Have Doubled the Cost of Tesla's AI4 Computer
items.titleZh: 記憶體缺貨漲價 馬斯克：特斯拉 AI4 電腦成本翻倍
items.teaser: DRAM 和 NAND 全球大缺貨，連特斯拉車上的 AI4 電腦都變成「兩倍貴」！傳三星記憶體產能已排到 2029 年，蘋果也改簽 4 到 5 年長約。
paras: Tesla CEO Elon Musk says the AI4 computer used in Tesla cars now costs twice as much as before. In a post on X on Sunday, he blamed the higher cost on rising prices for memory and storage chips.
特斯拉執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）表示，特斯拉汽車使用的 AI4 電腦，現在的成本是以前的兩倍。他週日在 X 上發文，把成本上升歸咎於記憶體和儲存晶片價格上漲。

The world is facing a serious shortage of DRAM and NAND memory chips. Samsung's memory production is reportedly booked through 2029, and Apple is reportedly moving to four- to five-year supply contracts.
全球正面臨嚴重的 DRAM 和 NAND 記憶體晶片短缺。據報導，三星的記憶體產能已經被訂到 2029 年，蘋果也傳出要改簽 4 到 5 年的長期供貨合約。

Musk did not give any dollar figures, and he did not say whether the higher cost will affect car prices or Full Self-Driving subscriptions. The head of memory maker TeamGroup, Gerry Chen, believes the DRAM shortage will become so severe in 2027 that money alone will not guarantee supply.
馬斯克沒有提出任何金額，也沒說成本上升會不會影響車價或「全自動輔助駕駛（FSD）」的訂閱費。記憶體廠十銓（TeamGroup）的執行長 Gerry Chen 認為，2027 年 DRAM 短缺會嚴重到光有錢也不保證買得到貨。
words: blames · blamed · blaming｜blame A on B 把 A 歸咎於 B｜n. blame 責任
不可數｜v. store 儲存｜storage chip 儲存晶片｜data storage 資料儲存
複數 shortages｜adj. short 短缺的｜a shortage of… …的短缺
複數 contracts｜sign a contract 簽約｜supply contract 供貨合約｜n. contractor 承包商
比較級 more severe｜adv. severely 嚴重地｜n. severity 嚴重性

analysis.zh: 他週日在 X 上發文，把成本上升歸咎於記憶體和儲存晶片價格上漲。
parts: on rising prices for memory and storage chips.
修飾（blame A on B 的 on B：歸咎的原因）
analysis.note: blame A on B＝把 A（壞結果）怪到 B（原因）頭上；也可以說 blame B for A＝因為 A 而怪 B。兩種順序相反，要注意介系詞：on 後面接原因，for 後面接結果。rising prices 的 rising 是現在分詞當形容詞，表示「正在上漲的」。

analysis.zh: 記憶體廠十銓的負責人 Gerry Chen 認為，2027 年 DRAM 短缺會嚴重到光有錢也不保證買得到貨。
parts: The head of memory maker TeamGroup,
the DRAM shortage will become so severe in 2027
名詞子句（省略 that，當 believes 的受詞）
that money alone will not guarantee supply.
analysis.note: so + 形容詞 + that + 子句＝「如此…以致於…」，這裡是 so severe that…（嚴重到…）。believes 後面接名詞子句時常省略 that，所以第一個 that 被省略，第二個 that 是 so…that 的 that，不能省略。money alone 的 alone 放在名詞後面，意思是「光是、單靠」。

quiz.q: What did Musk blame for the higher cost of AI4?
opts: Rising prices for memory and storage chips
quiz.ex: 第一段：he blamed the higher cost on rising prices for memory and storage chips。

quiz.q: According to reports, how far ahead is Samsung's memory production booked?
opts: For four to five years from 2029
quiz.ex: 第二段：Samsung's memory production is reportedly booked through 2029。4 到 5 年是蘋果合約的長度，2027 是 Gerry Chen 預測短缺最嚴重的年份。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Musk said exactly how many dollars AI4 costs.
Musk said car prices will go up.
Gerry Chen thinks money alone may not be enough to get DRAM in 2027.
The shortage only affects NAND chips.
quiz.ex: 第三段：money alone will not guarantee supply。馬斯克沒給金額、也沒說會不會漲車價；短缺同時包括 DRAM 和 NAND。

source.title: Wccftech：Elon Musk Blames Memory And Storage Price Hikes For Doubling Tesla's AI4 Computer Costs, Says It "Costs Twice As Much"（2026/11/22）

items.title: Taipei Mayoral Candidates Debate Child, Food and Water Safety
items.titleZh: 台北市長政見會 蔣萬安、沈伯洋交鋒兒少、食安與水源安全
items.teaser: 選前一週第二場電視政見發表會：沈伯洋批市府處理危機太慢，蔣萬安則要求中央強制幼兒園裝監視器，並反對在翡翠水庫設太陽能板。
paras: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an of the Kuomintang (KMT) and Puma Shen of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) met on Saturday for their second televised policy presentation. The two candidates are competing in the local elections on Nov. 28.
國民黨籍的台北市長蔣萬安和民進黨的沈伯洋，週六進行第二場電視政見發表會。兩位候選人將在 11 月 28 日的地方選舉中競爭。

Shen said the city had responded too slowly to problems such as an abuse case at a kindergarten and a 2024 food poisoning case that killed six people. "I would rather intervene too much than be late," he said, promising to suspend workers and close facilities immediately when abuse is confirmed.
沈伯洋說，市府處理問題的速度太慢，例如一間幼兒園的虐童案，以及 2024 年造成 6 人死亡的食物中毒案。他說：「在兒童安全上，我寧可介入太多，也不要太晚。」並承諾虐待一經證實，就立刻讓相關人員停職、關閉機構。

Chiang called on the central government to require surveillance cameras in kindergartens, noting that Taipei has fully subsidized them at private kindergartens since 2024. He also opposed putting solar panels at Feitsui Reservoir, saying, "Protecting our water sources takes more than slogans." The DPP accused the KMT of spreading rumors, pointing to government water tests.
蔣萬安呼籲中央政府強制幼兒園安裝監視器，並指出台北市從 2024 年起就全額補助私立幼兒園裝設。他也反對在翡翠水庫設置太陽能板，說：「保護水源不能只靠口號。」民進黨則以政府的水質檢測結果為依據，指控國民黨散播謠言。
words: 複數 candidates｜mayoral candidate 市長候選人｜n. candidacy 候選資格
intervenes · intervened · intervening｜n. intervention 介入｜intervene in… 介入…
suspends · suspended · suspending｜n. suspension 停職；暫停
不可數｜surveillance camera 監視器｜under surveillance 受到監視
accuses · accused · accusing｜accuse A of B 指控 A 做了 B｜n. accusation 指控

analysis.zh: 沈伯洋說，市府對一些問題反應太慢，例如一間幼兒園的虐童案，以及 2024 年造成 6 人死亡的食物中毒案。
parts: the city had responded too slowly
名詞子句（省略 that，當受詞；過去完成式）
修飾（respond to 對…做出反應）
such as an abuse case at a kindergarten and a 2024 food poisoning case
關係子句（修飾 a 2024 food poisoning case）
analysis.note: said 是過去式，而「市府反應太慢」發生在說話之前，所以子句用過去完成式 had responded，這是轉述句常見的時態後移。such as 用來舉例，後面接名詞。that killed six people 修飾最靠近的 a 2024 food poisoning case。

analysis.zh: 蔣萬安呼籲中央政府強制幼兒園安裝監視器，並指出台北市從 2024 年起就全額補助私立幼兒園裝設。
parts: to require surveillance cameras in kindergartens,
受詞補語（不定詞：呼籲對方去做的事）
noting that Taipei has fully subsidized them at private kindergartens since 2024.
analysis.note: call on + 人 + to V＝「呼籲某人去做某事」。noting that… 是分詞構句，主詞和主要子句一樣是 Chiang，等於 and he noted that…，新聞常用 noting / saying 補充說話者的理由。since 2024 搭配現在完成式 has subsidized，表示從過去持續到現在。

quiz.ex: 第一段：the local elections on Nov. 28。11 月 21 日（週六）是這場政見會。

quiz.q: What did Shen promise to do when abuse is confirmed?
opts: Suspend workers and close facilities immediately
Ask the central government for money
quiz.ex: 第二段：promising to suspend workers and close facilities immediately when abuse is confirmed。

opts: Chiang supports solar panels at Feitsui Reservoir.
The DPP agreed with the KMT about water safety.
Taipei has fully subsidized cameras at private kindergartens since 2024.
This was the first televised policy presentation.
quiz.ex: 第三段：Taipei has fully subsidized them at private kindergartens since 2024。蔣萬安反對設太陽能板；民進黨指控國民黨散播謠言；這是第二場政見會。

items.title: Who Was Buried in Westminster Abbey's Roman Coffin?
items.titleZh: 西敏寺羅馬石棺裡躺的是誰？150 年謎團可能解開
items.teaser: 石棺上刻的是羅馬時代富人的名字，裡面的骨骸卻來自約 1000 年前！放射性碳定年把答案縮小到兩位修道院院長。
paras: For about 150 years, people have wondered who was buried in a Roman stone coffin at Westminster Abbey in London. Its inscription names Valerius Amandinus, a wealthy Briton who lived sometime between 300 and 400 AD, but the coffin was later reused.
大約 150 年來，大家一直好奇倫敦西敏寺裡一具羅馬石棺埋葬的是誰。石棺上的銘文寫著 Valerius Amandinus，他是西元 300 到 400 年間某個時候的一位富有不列顛人，但這具石棺後來被重複使用了。

In 2016, experts lifted the lid and found an almost complete skeleton inside. Radiocarbon tests now date the bones to between 987 and 1052 AD, and they belonged to a man aged 35 to 49 who was about 5 feet 9 inches tall.
2016 年，專家掀開棺蓋，在裡面發現一具幾乎完整的骨骸。放射性碳定年現在把這些骨頭定在西元 987 到 1052 年之間，主人是一名 35 到 49 歲、身高大約 5 呎 9 吋（約 175 公分）的男性。

Archaeologist Warwick Rodwell says the strongest candidate is Aelfwig, an abbot who died around 1020. Another possibility is Wulnoth, who took over after him and died in 1049. Rodwell says there are "two viable contenders," so the mystery is not completely solved yet.
考古學家羅德威爾（Warwick Rodwell）說，最有可能的人選是大約 1020 年過世的修道院院長艾爾夫維格（Aelfwig）。另一個可能是接替他、在 1049 年過世的伍爾諾斯（Wulnoth）。羅德威爾說目前有「兩位可信的人選」，所以謎團還沒有完全解開。
words: 複數 abbots｜n. abbey 修道院；大教堂（如 Westminster Abbey 西敏寺）｜女性為 abbess
（刻在石頭、金屬上的）銘文、題字
複數 inscriptions｜v. inscribe 刻寫
wealthier · wealthiest｜n. wealth 財富｜the wealthy 富人
複數 skeletons｜adj. skeletal 骨骼的｜a complete skeleton 完整的骨骸
複數 possibilities｜adj. possible 可能的｜adv. possibly 可能地

analysis.zh: 石棺上的銘文寫著 Valerius Amandinus——他是西元 300 到 400 年間某個時候的一位富有不列顛人，但這具石棺後來被重複使用了。
parts: 同位語（說明這個人是誰）
who lived sometime between 300 and 400 AD,
關係子句（修飾 a wealthy Briton）
but the coffin was later reused.
對等子句（but 表轉折；被動語態）
analysis.note: names 在這裡是動詞「寫出名字、點名」，不是名詞複數，要從句子位置判斷。a wealthy Briton 是同位語，緊接在人名後面補充身分。was reused 是過去式被動語態（be + p.p.），因為重點是石棺「被」再利用，不知道或不重要是誰做的。

analysis.zh: 放射性碳定年現在把骨頭定在西元 987 到 1052 年之間，主人是一名 35 到 49 歲、身高約 5 呎 9 吋的男性。
parts: 修飾（date A to B：把 A 的年代定在 B）
and they belonged to a man
修飾（年齡，aged 當形容詞）
who was about 5 feet 9 inches tall.
關係子句（修飾 a man）
analysis.note: date 當動詞是「判定…的年代」，常用 date A to + 時間。belong to 是「屬於」，不用進行式也不用被動。a man aged 35 to 49 的 aged 是形容詞，意思是「…歲的」，放在名詞後面，等於 a man who was 35 to 49 years old。

quiz.q: Whose name is written on the coffin?
quiz.ex: 第一段：Its inscription names Valerius Amandinus。Aelfwig 和 Wulnoth 是可能的棺內人選，Rodwell 是考古學家。

quiz.q: When was the skeleton found inside the coffin?
quiz.ex: 第二段：In 2016, experts lifted the lid and found an almost complete skeleton inside。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The bones are from the Roman period.
The man was about 5 feet 9 inches tall.
Scientists are completely sure who the man was.
quiz.ex: 第二段：a man … who was about 5 feet 9 inches tall。骨頭是 987 到 1052 年的，不是羅馬時代；目前有兩位人選，還不確定；Wulnoth 接替 Aelfwig，比較晚過世。

items.title: Murray Scores 45 as Nuggets Beat Bulls 151-145 in Overtime
items.titleZh: 穆雷狂砍 45 分 金塊延長賽 151 比 145 擊敗公牛
items.teaser: 穆雷 45 分、約基奇 37 分大三元，金塊和公牛打出總分 296 分的超級對攻戰；這對搭檔還一起寫下 NBA 史上最多次的紀錄。
paras: Jamal Murray scored 45 points and Nikola Jokić added 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists as the Denver Nuggets beat the Chicago Bulls 151-145 in overtime on Sunday. The wild game featured 296 total points and 39 three-pointers.
丹佛金塊週日在延長賽以 151 比 145 擊敗芝加哥公牛，穆雷（Jamal Murray）攻下 45 分，約基奇（Nikola Jokić）也有 37 分、18 籃板和 11 助攻。這場瘋狂的比賽兩隊總共拿下 296 分，還投進 39 記三分球。

Chicago's Josh Giddey forced overtime with a game-tying layup with 2.1 seconds left. He finished with 23 points, 14 rebounds and 22 assists. In overtime, however, Denver outscored Chicago 20-14, and Murray and Jokić scored or assisted on all 20 of those points.
公牛的吉迪（Josh Giddey）在比賽剩 2.1 秒時上籃追平，把比賽逼進延長賽。他全場拿下 23 分、14 籃板和 22 助攻。不過在延長賽裡，金塊以 20 比 14 壓過公牛，而這 20 分全都是穆雷和約基奇自己得分或助攻的。

According to NBA.com, it was the eighth time Murray has scored 40 or more points while Jokić recorded a triple-double in the same game, the most by any pair in NBA history. "I thought the reaction in overtime is who we are," said Nuggets coach David Adelman. Denver has now won three straight games.
根據 NBA 官網，這是穆雷第八次在約基奇拿下大三元的同一場比賽中攻下 40 分以上，是 NBA 史上所有搭檔中最多的。金塊總教練亞德曼（David Adelman）說：「我覺得我們在延長賽的反應，就是我們這支球隊的本色。」金塊目前已經三連勝。
words: 不可數｜in overtime 在延長賽中｜work overtime 加班
features · featured · featuring｜n. feature 特色；特寫報導
forces · forced · forcing｜force overtime 逼進延長賽｜n. force 力量
複數 assists｜v. assist 協助（assists · assisted · assisting）｜n. assistant 助理
複數 pairs｜a pair of… 一雙…｜v. pair 配對（pairs · paired · pairing）

analysis.zh: 公牛的吉迪在比賽剩 2.1 秒時上籃追平，把比賽逼進延長賽。
parts: 修飾（with + 名詞 + 分詞，表示當時狀況）
analysis.note: 兩個 with 用法不同：with a game-tying layup 是「用一記追平的上籃」，表示方法；with 2.1 seconds left 是「with + 名詞 + 過去分詞」的附帶狀況，表示「剩下 2.1 秒時」。game-tying 是「名詞 + 現在分詞」組成的複合形容詞，類似 record-breaking（破紀錄的）。

items.title: TSMC Says Advanced Chip Capacity Is Still Sold Out
items.titleZh: 台積電：先進製程產能依然滿載
items.teaser: AI 泡沫疑慮讓晶片股大震盪，台積電出面表示 AI 需求還在成長、先進製程產能仍然售罄，高層也說沒看到客戶調整訂單。
paras: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) said on Monday that global demand for AI keeps growing and that its capacity for advanced chips remains sold out. The company said AI is moving beyond chatbots toward AI assistants and "agentic AI."
台積電週一表示，全球 AI 需求持續成長，先進製程晶片的產能依然全部售罄。公司也說，AI 正從聊天機器人，走向 AI 助理和「代理式 AI」。

The statement came after worries about an AI bubble shook chip stocks. Speaking at an industry forum called by Premier Cho Jung-tai on the same day, TSMC senior vice president Y.J. Hou said he had not seen any customers adjust their orders or shipments. He added that long-term demand remains strong.
這份聲明是在 AI 泡沫的疑慮撼動晶片股之後發出的。同一天，台積電資深副總經理侯永清在行政院長卓榮泰召集的產業論壇上表示，他沒有看到任何客戶調整訂單或出貨，並補充說長期需求依然強勁。

Terry Tsao, president of SEMI's Taiwan region, said he expects Taiwan's chip supply chain to stay sold out through 2028 and 2029. Economic Affairs Minister Kung Ming-hsin described the recent market shock as short-term. TSMC shares in Taipei closed up 1.5% at NT$2,030.
國際半導體產業協會（SEMI）台灣區總裁曹世綸表示，他預期台灣的晶片供應鏈到 2028、2029 年都會維持滿載。經濟部長龔明鑫則形容最近的市場震盪只是短期現象。台積電股價在台北收漲 1.5%，收在 2,030 元。

items.title: MAC Warns of China's Election Interference Ahead of Local Polls
items.titleZh: 九合一投票前夕 陸委會示警中國介選
items.teaser: 投票日前五天，陸委會提醒中國介選手法隨科技越來越精密；被起訴的民眾黨桃園議員參選人則否認指控。
paras: Five days before Taiwan's local elections on Nov. 28, the Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) warned that China's ways of interfering in elections are becoming more sophisticated with new technology. MAC deputy head Shen Yu-chung pointed to funding candidates, cognitive warfare and underground election betting.
在台灣 11 月 28 日地方選舉的五天前，大陸委員會（陸委會）提醒，中國介入選舉的手法正隨著新科技變得越來越精密。陸委會副主委沈有忠點出資助候選人、認知作戰，以及地下選舉賭盤等手法。

Shen also said China's progress in AI and facial recognition could let it collect information beyond elections and into people's daily lives. He urged Taiwanese to stay alert and called on Beijing to view Taiwan's elections objectively.
沈有忠也說，中國在 AI 和人臉辨識上的進展，可能讓它蒐集資訊的範圍超出選舉、延伸到民眾的日常生活。他呼籲國人保持警覺，也呼籲北京客觀看待台灣的選舉。

His remarks followed the indictment of Chou Hsiao-yun, a Taiwan People's Party (TPP) candidate for the Taoyuan City Council. Prosecutors allege she traveled to Xiamen three times in 2025, received money and ran a network of fake Facebook accounts. Chou denied the charges. TPP Chairman Huang Kuo-chang said he respected her right to defend herself, but party candidates must clearly answer the allegations.
他發言之前，民眾黨桃園市議員參選人周曉芸剛被起訴。檢方指控她在 2025 年三度前往廈門、收受金錢，並經營假臉書帳號網路。周曉芸否認這些指控。民眾黨主席黃國昌說，他尊重她為自己辯護的權利，但黨籍候選人必須清楚回應這些指控。

items.title: 194-Year-Old Tortoise Jonathan Has Anti-Aging Secrets in His DNA
items.titleZh: 194 歲象龜強納森 DNA 裡藏著抗老祕密
items.teaser: 世界上最老的陸地動物、1832 年孵化的象龜強納森，科學家在他的基因裡找到 287 個跟抗老有關的變異。
paras: Jonathan, a giant tortoise living on the island of St. Helena, is about 194 years old. He is believed to have hatched in 1832, which makes him the oldest known living land animal. Now scientists have studied his DNA to learn how he has lived so long.
住在聖赫勒拿島上的象龜強納森，大約 194 歲了。一般認為他在 1832 年孵化，這讓他成為目前已知最老、還活著的陸地動物。現在科學家研究了他的 DNA，想知道他為什麼能活這麼久。

The researchers found 287 special genetic variants linked to protection against aging. They are related to repairing DNA, limiting inflammation, controlling insulin and fighting cancer. The team also compared Jonathan's epigenome, the chemical markers that switch genes on and off, with those of younger tortoises of the same species.
研究人員找到 287 個和抗老化有關的特殊基因變異，跟修復 DNA、限制發炎、控制胰島素和對抗癌症有關。團隊也把強納森的表觀基因組（也就是開關基因的化學標記）拿來和同種、較年輕的象龜比較。

The gene regulators involved in energy production and DNA repair have remained "incredibly stable," said Justin Gerlach of the University of Cambridge. The study was published in Science Advances. However, the researchers say more work is needed before the findings can help humans.
劍橋大學的 Justin Gerlach 說，負責能量製造和 DNA 修復的基因調控因子一直「穩定得驚人」。這項研究刊登在《科學進展》（Science Advances）期刊。不過研究人員表示，這些發現要能幫助人類，還需要更多研究。

不可數（或複數 inflammations）｜adj. inflammatory 發炎的
單複數同形 species｜the same species 同一物種

非限定關係子句（which 指前面整件事）
analysis.note: be believed to have + p.p. 表示「一般認為（過去）已經…」：用完成式不定詞，是因為孵化發生在「相信」之前。這個句型等於 People believe that he hatched in 1832。逗號後的 which 不是指 1832，而是指前面整件事，翻成「這讓…」。

with those of younger tortoises of the same species.

analysis.note: compare A with B 是「把 A 和 B 比較」。those 代替前面的 epigenome（指年輕象龜的表觀基因組），避免重複名詞，比較句常用 that of / those of。兩個逗號中間的 the chemical markers… 是同位語，用簡單的話解釋難字，科普文章很常見。

items.title: McDaniels Scores Career-High 34 as Timberwolves Crush Nets 142-116
items.titleZh: 麥克丹尼爾斯生涯新高 34 分 灰狼 142 比 116 大勝籃網
items.teaser: 麥克丹尼爾斯 16 投 12 中、三分 4 投全進，灰狼六人得分上雙；回到明尼蘇達的藍道（Julius Randle）拿 29 分也救不了籃網的五連敗。
paras: Jaden McDaniels scored a career-high 34 points as the Minnesota Timberwolves crushed the Brooklyn Nets 142-116 on Monday night. McDaniels made 12 of his 16 shots, including all four of his three-pointers, and also had 10 rebounds and six assists.
灰狼週一晚上以 142 比 116 大勝布魯克林籃網，麥克丹尼爾斯（Jaden McDaniels）攻下生涯新高 34 分。他 16 次出手命中 12 球，其中 4 記三分球全部投進，另外還有 10 籃板和 6 助攻。

Six Minnesota players scored in double figures. Ayo Dosunmu added 23 points, Terrence Shannon Jr. and LaMelo Ball each had 17, and Jonathan Kuminga scored 15. The 142 points were the most Minnesota has scored in a game this season.
灰狼有六名球員得分上雙。杜森穆（Ayo Dosunmu）貢獻 23 分，夏儂（Terrence Shannon Jr.）和拉梅洛・鮑爾（LaMelo Ball）各拿 17 分，庫明加（Jonathan Kuminga）也有 15 分。142 分是灰狼本季單場最高得分。

Former Timberwolves player Julius Randle led Brooklyn with 29 points in his first game back in Minnesota, where he received a video tribute before the game. The Nets made 18 of 36 three-pointers, their best rate of the season, but they still lost their fifth straight game and fell to 3-13. Minnesota improved to 13-5.
前灰狼球員藍道（Julius Randle）以 29 分領軍籃網，這是他離隊後第一次回到明尼蘇達出賽，賽前主場還播放影片向他致敬。籃網三分球 36 投 18 中，是本季最佳命中率，但仍吞下五連敗，戰績掉到 3 勝 13 敗；灰狼則提升到 13 勝 5 敗。

items.title: TSMC Gains $158 Billion in a Day as Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia
items.titleZh: 黃仁勳回任輝達執行長 台積電一天市值大增 1580 億美元
items.teaser: 輝達董事會投票讓黃仁勳回任執行長，台積電股價亮燈漲停，一天增加 5.2 兆台幣市值；台股前一週才創下 1991 年以來最慘週跌幅。
paras: Shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) jumped 9.9% on Tuesday, the maximum daily rise allowed, adding about NT$5.2 trillion, or $158 billion, to the chipmaker's market value. The rally came after Nvidia's board voted on Monday to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO.
台積電股價週二大漲 9.9%，也就是單日漲幅上限（漲停），讓這家晶片製造商的市值一天增加約新台幣 5.2 兆元，相當於 1580 億美元。這波大漲發生在輝達董事會週一投票、讓黃仁勳重新擔任執行長之後。

Huang had stepped down on Nov. 12. Nvidia's board said it was "confident that Mr. Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk." Chip stocks across Asia also rose: South Korea's SK Hynix gained 6.7% and Samsung 6.6%, while Japanese memory maker Kioxia climbed 10%.
黃仁勳在 11 月 12 日卸任。輝達董事會表示，他們「有信心黃仁勳回任不會帶來任何國家安全風險」。亞洲各地的晶片股也跟著上漲：南韓的 SK 海力士漲 6.7%、三星漲 6.6%，日本記憶體大廠鎧俠（Kioxia）也漲了 10%。

Taiwan's main stock index, the TAIEX, climbed 9% after falling 17.5% the week before, its worst weekly drop since 1991. "This looks like a powerful relief rally," said Charu Chanana of Saxo. However, the U.S. has also expanded its export controls on AI chips to more countries, including Singapore and Malaysia.
台灣主要股價指數「加權指數」上漲 9%，而它前一週才重挫 17.5%，是 1991 年以來最大的單週跌幅。盛寶銀行（Saxo）的 Charu Chanana 說：「這看起來是一波強力的解脫性反彈。」不過，美國也把 AI 晶片的出口管制擴大到更多國家，包括新加坡和馬來西亞。

items.title: Nearly 19.6 Million Eligible to Vote in Taiwan's Local Elections
items.titleZh: 九合一選舉近 1960 萬人有投票權
items.teaser: 中選會公布選舉人數：縣市長近 1960 萬人可投票，同日的核電公投因 18 歲就能投，超過 2000 萬人有投票權。
paras: Nearly 19.6 million people are eligible to vote for mayors and county magistrates in Taiwan's local elections on Saturday, Nov. 28, the Central Election Commission (CEC) said on Tuesday. A total of 11,051 public posts will be filled in the elections.
中央選舉委員會（中選會）週二表示，11 月 28 日星期六的地方選舉中，有將近 1960 萬人有資格投票選出直轄市長和縣市長。這次選舉總共要選出 11,051 個公職。

A national referendum will be held on the same day. It asks whether Taiwan should promote nuclear power and abandon its nuclear-free homeland policy. Because the voting age for referendums is 18, while it is 20 for local elections, more than 20 million people can vote in the referendum, including 402,980 voters aged 18 or 19.
同一天也會舉行全國性公投，題目是台灣是否應推動核能發電、放棄「非核家園」政策。因為公投的投票年齡是 18 歲，地方選舉則是 20 歲，所以公投有超過 2000 萬人可以投票，其中包括 402,980 名 18 或 19 歲的選民。

New Taipei has the largest number of eligible voters for mayor, about 3.43 million, followed by Taichung and Kaohsiung. More than 310,000 election workers will help on election day, and vote counting is expected to finish by midnight on Saturday.
新北市的市長選舉人數最多，約 343 萬人，其次是台中市和高雄市。投票日當天會有超過 31 萬名選務人員協助，開票預計在星期六午夜前完成。

複數 referendums / referenda｜hold a referendum 舉行公投
abandons · abandoned · abandoning｜adj. abandoned 被遺棄的
expects · expected · expecting｜be expected to V 預計會…｜n. expectation 期望

quiz.ex: 第一段：Taiwan's local elections on Saturday, Nov. 28。週二是中選會公布數字的日子。

Because New Taipei has more voters.

items.title: New Materials Can Crawl, Walk and Dig Like Living Creatures
items.titleZh: 會爬、會走還會挖洞的新材料
items.teaser: 在細桿的關節裝上微型馬達，原本只會彎曲或折斷的材料竟然能自己動起來；另一項研究還發現，零件越「主動」，整體反應有時反而越小。
paras: Scientists from the universities of Amsterdam, Cambridge and New South Wales have designed new "active" materials that can crawl, walk and even dig like living creatures. Their results were published in two studies, one in the journal PNAS and the other in Physical Review X.
來自阿姆斯特丹大學、劍橋大學和新南威爾斯大學的科學家，設計出能像生物一樣爬行、行走，甚至挖洞的新型「主動」材料。研究成果發表在兩篇論文中，一篇刊在《美國國家科學院院刊》（PNAS），另一篇刊在《物理評論 X》。

In the first study, the team placed tiny motors at the joints of thin rods. Normally, a rod under pressure simply bends or snaps, but the motors turned these movements into repeated back-and-forth motions, which allowed the rods to move on their own.
在第一項研究中，團隊把微型馬達裝在細桿的關節上。一般來說，細桿受到壓力時只會彎曲或突然折彎，但這些馬達把這些動作變成反覆的來回擺動，讓細桿能夠自己移動。

The second study found something surprising: in some networks, making each part more active can actually make the whole material respond less. The researchers say their findings could help scientists design soft robots and better understand biological materials such as gels and layers of cells.
第二項研究則有個出人意料的發現：在某些網狀結構中，讓每個零件更「主動」，反而可能讓整個材料的反應變小。研究人員表示，這些發現能幫助科學家設計軟體機器人，也能更了解凝膠、細胞層等生物材料。
words: 複數 creatures｜living creatures 生物｜v. create 創造
複數 joints｜adj. joint 共同的（a joint study 共同研究）
snaps · snapped · snapping｜n. snap 斷裂聲
adv. repeatedly 一再地｜v. repeat 重複（repeats · repeated · repeating）
responds · responded · responding｜n. response 反應｜respond to… 對…做出反應

analysis.zh: 一般來說，細桿受到壓力時只會彎曲或突然折彎，但這些馬達把這些動作變成反覆的來回擺動，讓細桿能夠自己移動。
parts: 主詞（介系詞片語修飾 rod）
主詞（but 連接第二個子句）
修飾（turn A into B 把 A 變成 B）
which allowed the rods to move on their own.
關係子句（which 指前面整件事）
analysis.note: turn A into B 是「把 A 變成 B」。逗號後的 which 不是只指 motions，而是指前面整件事（馬達讓動作變成擺動這件事），屬於「非限定關係子句」。allow + 受詞 + to V 表示「讓…能夠…」；on their own 是「靠自己、獨立地」。

analysis.zh: 第二項研究有個出人意料的發現：在某些網狀結構中，讓每個零件更主動，反而可能讓整個材料的反應變小。
parts: 受詞（形容詞放在 something 後面）
analysis.note: 冒號後面的句子在解釋 something surprising 是什麼。這個句子的主詞是動名詞片語 making each part more active（讓每個零件更主動）。make + 受詞 + 原形動詞是使役用法：make the material respond less「讓材料反應變小」。另外，修飾 something、anything 的形容詞要放在後面，例如 something new。

opts: At the joints of thin rods

quiz.q: What did the second study find?
opts: More active parts can sometimes make the whole material respond less.
Soft robots are already on sale.
quiz.ex: 第三段：making each part more active can actually make the whole material respond less。

opts: The results were published in only one study.
The research was done by a single university.
The findings may help in designing soft robots.
The motors stopped the rods from moving.

items.title: Flagg Leads Mavericks Past Nuggets 120-101 in NBA Cup
items.titleZh: 弗拉格 24 分 11 助攻 獨行俠 120 比 101 擊敗金塊
items.teaser: 獨行俠快攻得分以 35 比 7 壓倒金塊，NBA 盃小組賽三戰全勝；只要太陽週三輸球，就能拿到八強門票。
paras: Cooper Flagg had 24 points and 11 assists as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Denver Nuggets 120-101 on Monday night in an Emirates NBA Cup group game. Flagg led seven Dallas players who scored in double figures. "I think I've grown a lot," he said about creating chances for his teammates.
弗拉格（Cooper Flagg）攻下 24 分、11 助攻，帶領達拉斯獨行俠週一晚上在 NBA 盃小組賽以 120 比 101 擊敗丹佛金塊。獨行俠有七名球員得分上雙，弗拉格是其中的領頭羊。談到幫隊友製造機會，他說：「我覺得自己成長了很多。」

Dallas closed the first half with a 15-0 run and led 58-39 at halftime. Denver fought back by winning the third quarter 38-26, but the Mavericks still led 84-77 going into the fourth. Dallas also had a huge 35-7 advantage in fast-break points.
獨行俠上半場最後打出一波 15 比 0，半場以 58 比 39 領先。金塊靠著第三節 38 比 26 追近比分，但進入第四節時獨行俠仍以 84 比 77 領先。獨行俠的快攻得分更以 35 比 7 大幅領先。

Both teams had entered the game at 2-0 in West Group A. With the win, Dallas improved to 3-0 and will secure a place in the quarterfinals if the Phoenix Suns lose on Wednesday. The Boston Celtics also moved to 3-0 after Jayson Tatum scored 41 points in a 131-116 win over the Washington Wizards.
兩隊賽前在西區 A 組都是 2 戰全勝。贏球後獨行俠提升到 3 勝 0 敗，只要鳳凰城太陽週三輸球，就能確定晉級八強。波士頓塞爾提克也以 131 比 116 擊敗華盛頓巫師，塔圖姆（Jayson Tatum）轟下 41 分，同樣取得 3 勝 0 敗。

opts: Denver must win its next game.

items.title: Chip Stocks Tumble Again as Investors Pull Back From AI
items.titleZh: 投資人撤出 AI 題材 輝達、美光等晶片股再度重挫
items.teaser: 黃仁勳回任帶動的大漲沒撐多久：輝達週二跌 6%、週三盤前再跌 5%，記憶體大廠美光和 SK 海力士也各跌 6%。
paras: Chip stocks fell sharply again on Wednesday as investors sold shares linked to artificial intelligence. Nvidia dropped another 5% in premarket trading after losing 6% the day before, and its rivals AMD and Broadcom also extended their losses.
週三晶片股再度大跌，投資人紛紛賣出和人工智慧相關的股票。輝達前一天已經跌了 6%，週三盤前交易又再跌 5%；對手超微（AMD）和博通（Broadcom）也跌勢未止。

Memory chipmakers were hit hard too. Micron and SK Hynix each fell 6%, and Micron's stock is now about 50% below its all-time high from the summer. Storage companies such as Seagate, Western Digital and SanDisk also declined.
記憶體晶片廠同樣重傷。美光和 SK 海力士各跌 6%，美光股價目前比今年夏天的歷史高點低了大約 50%。希捷、威騰電子和 SanDisk 等儲存裝置公司也都下跌。

The sell-off came just two days after Nvidia's shares jumped 31% when its board brought back Jensen Huang as CEO. "There is still a lot of nervousness out there," said David Morrison, a senior market analyst at Trade Nation. Some strategists say tighter financial conditions are also weighing on investors.
這波賣壓距離輝達股價大漲 31% 才過兩天——當時輝達董事會讓黃仁勳回任執行長。Trade Nation 資深市場分析師 David Morrison 說：「市場上還是瀰漫著很多緊張情緒。」也有策略分析師表示，資金環境變緊也讓投資人更加不安。

items.title: Party Leaders Hit the Campaign Trail as Taiwan's Local Elections Near
items.titleZh: 九合一選舉倒數 各黨領袖全台輔選
items.teaser: 週六投票前最後衝刺：賴清德、蕭美琴、蔡英文為民進黨站台，國民黨主席鄭麗文、民眾黨的柯文哲和黃國昌也四處掃街拜票。
paras: With less than three days to go before Saturday's local elections, Taiwan's political parties stepped up their campaigns on Wednesday. Voters in all 22 cities and counties will choose people for nine kinds of local posts, from mayors to ward chiefs. In total, 11,051 officials will be elected.
距離週六的地方選舉只剩不到三天，台灣各政黨週三加緊競選活動。全台 22 個縣市的選民將選出九種地方公職，從縣市長到村里長都有，總共要選出 11,051 名公職人員。

President Lai Ching-te, who also chairs the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), campaigned in Nantou and Taichung, while Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and former President Tsai Ing-wen attended a rally in Miaoli. Kuomintang (KMT) Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun joined a motorcade in Hsinchu County. Taiwan People's Party (TPP) founder Ko Wen-je and Chairman Huang Kuo-chang campaigned in Nantou and other areas.
兼任執政黨民進黨主席的賴清德總統到南投和台中輔選，副總統蕭美琴和前總統蔡英文則出席苗栗的造勢晚會。國民黨主席鄭麗文在新竹縣參加車隊掃街。民眾黨創黨主席柯文哲和現任主席黃國昌，也到南投和其他地區拜票。

In Taipei, incumbent KMT Mayor Chiang Wan-an and DPP challenger Puma Shen toured different districts. In New Taipei, KMT candidate Lee Shu-chuan and DPP legislator Su Chiao-hui held motorcades and visited markets. Polling stations will be open from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturday.
在台北，尋求連任的國民黨籍市長蔣萬安和民進黨挑戰者沈伯洋分別走訪市內不同行政區。在新北，國民黨候選人李四川和民進黨立委蘇巧慧也都進行車隊掃街並到市場拜票。投票所週六早上 8 點開到下午 4 點。

items.title: Dark Matter Telescope Euclid Finds Its First New Comet
items.titleZh: 尋找暗物質的歐幾里得望遠鏡 意外發現第一顆新彗星
items.teaser: 赫爾辛基大學博士生自己寫的程式，在好幾張影像裡抓到一道「拖痕」，原來是一顆約 13 億公里外、繞太陽一圈要好幾千年的彗星。
paras: The European Space Agency's Euclid space telescope was built to study dark matter, but it has just found something unexpected: a new comet. It is the first comet that Euclid has discovered, and it has been named C/2026 S1 (Euclid).
歐洲太空總署的歐幾里得（Euclid）太空望遠鏡原本是為了研究暗物質而打造的，卻意外發現了一樣東西：一顆新彗星。這是歐幾里得發現的第一顆彗星，被命名為 C/2026 S1（Euclid）。

The comet was spotted by Mikko Pöntinen, a PhD student at the University of Helsinki, using software he built. "I was excited to see my software flag a 'streak' smeared across several images," he said. The images were taken between September 16 and 24, and the comet was officially confirmed on October 8.
發現這顆彗星的是赫爾辛基大學博士生 Mikko Pöntinen，用的是他自己開發的軟體。他說：「看到我的軟體標出一道橫跨好幾張影像的『拖痕』，我非常興奮。」這些影像拍攝於 9 月 16 日到 24 日，彗星在 10 月 8 日獲得正式確認。

The comet is about 1.3 billion kilometers from Earth, somewhere between the orbits of Jupiter and Saturn, and it takes thousands of years to go around the Sun. Euclid usually avoids the dusty area near the plane of the solar system. The team called the discovery "a happy coincidence" because very few comets were expected.
這顆彗星距離地球約 13 億公里，大約在木星和土星的軌道之間，繞太陽一圈要好幾千年。歐幾里得通常會避開太陽系平面附近塵埃多的區域，團隊原本預期很少能發現彗星，所以稱這次發現是「一個美好的巧合」。
